scope: Address-level map placement for advertised places and services. Only source-supported locations are added to city maps; locality centers are not used as premises.
method: Block and intersection anchors use the streets stated in the notice, with the exact geometry-service query preserved.
Approximate pins do not identify a historical parcel or surviving building.
Multiple addresses belonging to one advertiser remain separate locations; two notices of the same National Hotel share one geographic location.
Institutional correspondence addresses are held separately from premises.
Existing cited historical buildings are reused rather than duplicated.

All recorded dates is the default for cities with advertised addresses. Selecting a year shows advertised-location pins only for their documented notice years; it does not infer a continuous lifespan.
